stages.headline: The volume of a right prism is base area times height: V = S(base) · h.
stages.headlineEnglish: The volume of a right prism is base area times height: V = S(base) · h.

stages.headline: An oblique prism also has V = S(base) · h, where h is the height, not the lateral edge.
stages.headlineEnglish: An oblique prism also has V = S(base) · h, where h is the height, not the lateral edge.

stages.headline: If the lateral edge l makes an angle φ with the base, then h = l sin φ.
stages.headlineEnglish: If the lateral edge l makes an angle φ with the base, then h = l sin φ.
